Detail: Reference for how Maja generates polls/quizzes every ~4 hours
OPENAI_MODEL default gpt-4o-mini (OpenRouter if key starts with sk-or-)

Two agents, two pools: (1) English Content Agent invents EN cards (content_lang=en); (2) Hindi Content Agent invents original HI cards (content_lang=hi). Feed filters by lang. No EN→HI localization on publish.
~20 EN + ~20 HI cards per onboarding category per refresh
No short TTL — previous live moments retired only after the new batch is live
cricket, movies, music, pop-culture, food, gaming, sports, news, tech, personality-vibe, fashion, health, kpop, puzzles, logical-reasoning, math-numbers
cricket, kpop, movies, music, news, pop-culture, sports, tech

Agent System Prompt = English-only LLM system message. Hindi Generate = separate Hindi generation system message (invents original HI cards). Agent User Payload = JSON user message schema. Shared Rules = rules[] sent every category. Category Scope/Rules = sports vs cricket extras. Evergreen Polls/Quizzes = EN bank templates only. Brief Templates = verified event cards. Meme Pack = EN memegen image polls. Hindi Localize = obsolete for feed publish (kept for legacy tests). Poll Gen & Feed = how polls are created and shown. Trends Input = ops-maintained India trends JSON per category.
Ops fill backend/scripts/content_gen/trends/{category}.json before refresh. Merged with briefs into verifiedTrends. Model must not invent trending claims.
